subject: Post-call exec recap - HelioHealth (exec sponsor: Park)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap - HelioHealth (exec sponsor: Park)

Thanks again for taking the time today, Daniel — great discussion. Quick recap from our exec-level conversation and agreed next steps. Please reply with any clarifications; I captured commitments below.

Key pain points you shared
- High per-request inference cost for patient-facing workflows (peeks of costly bursts)
- Inconsistent latency for peak loads impacting SLAs with care providers
- Regulatory constraint: certain models/data must remain within your VPC/region

Business outcomes HelioHealth is targeting
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~35-45% vs current infra within 6 months
- Achieve 99.9% latency SLO for patient-facing endpoints (p95 target)
- Ensure data residency and auditability for compliance reviews

Risks / outstanding items
- Security/compliance review (SOC 2 evidence, data residency confirmation) — Sara to confirm requirements
- Procurement & budget cycle: you mentioned headcount changes could impact timeline
- Exec-level approval required for reserved capacity procurement

Agreed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive (Redwood infra + quantized model options) — propose Wed 6/23 (tech leads). (Action: Aditya)
2) Security questionnaire + sample evidence (Action: Marissa & Security) — we attached an initial MOP and can share SOC artifacts after NDA
3) Procurement path & timeline — you to introduce procurement lead (Action: Daniel / Sara)
4) Executive one-pager (business outcomes, cost model, risk mitigations) for your internal sponsor (Action: Laura)

Proposed dates:
- Tech deep-dive: Wed 2027-06-23 10:00 PT (tentative)
- Exec summary delivery: by EOD Mon 2027-06-21

Attachments: [Attachment: 20270620-heliohealth-mop-v1.pdf] (high-level model ops plan + costing sketch)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/23871

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliohealth.com>

Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap - HelioHealth (exec sponsor: Park)

Marissa / team — thanks for the concise recap. Confirming a few items from my side:
- We are very interested in the cost reductions and predictable latency story.
- Procurement timeline: our FYQ3 budget window closes 7/15, so we'd like to lock commercial terms before then if possible.
- I'll introduce Sara (procurement) who will own the purchasing path and contracts.

A couple of asks:
- Can you include a short SSO/KMS note for our security team? They require details on key management and audit logs.
- Please confirm whether reserved capacity can be scoped to specific VPC subnets (we need that for certain PHI workflows).

I've attached our initial security worksheet for context.

[Attachment: heliohealth-security-reqs.xlsx]

—
Daniel Park
